Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. At the very top and bottom edges: the foot of the stone walls with half-formed clay bodies emerging from the stone, made precisely and calmly, unfinished, not grotesque. Colors: near-black stone, cold white-green crystal light, pale sand, warm ochre clay as the only warm accent. No grid, no characters on the playfield.
